lessons_used: Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin, as only sign-in hints (sign_in, hint), finish new screens (finish, new_screen), and adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) have at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and new finish screens (finish, new_screen) were helpful as both included winning tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) showed no positive effect, with one test having no clear effect and another performing worse.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too low for sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.6% noise-corrected) and the post-onboarding control guide (+1.2% predicted vs +2.2% noise-corrected).

candidates.title: Finish First Interaction Playground Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive pet control practice screen immediately after home intro where users test hiding, dragging, and chatting with their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding pets, and lessons show finish new screens drive conversion wins.

new_finish_playground.headline: Try Controlling Your Desktop Pet
new_finish_playground.body: Practice dragging, hiding, and talking to your pet right here before finishing setup.

components.text: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls or hide it to system tray.

guard.reason: Adding a playground screen after home intro within onboarding is permitted by rule 4 and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage drops 26.9% of users. Historical finish new_screen tests show consistent positive lift (+1.8%). Requires new UI screen build.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Safeguard Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add a reminder hint on sign_in instructing users to log in with their original auth method to prevent duplicate empty accounts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven effective in past winning tests.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account method to keep your adopted pet and saved settings.

guard.reason: Adding guidance hints to the sign-in screen is valid under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Top complaint in support emails (8 tickets). Sign-in hints have 3 tests with proven overall positive gains.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Waiting Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout with notification alerts and desktop tray troubleshooting hints during setup.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a long mean time of 2336s, and 3 support mails cited pets failing to show on desktop or app launch issues.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace
waiting.body: We are placing your pet on your desktop. If your pet is not visible, check your system tray.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen while preserving its core function of showing pet creation is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High wait time on home stage, but historical redesigns across home and adoption consistently underperformed or regressed.

candidates.title: Post Home Companion Controls Flow
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated companion controls guide step at the end of onboarding highlighting desktop tray and shortcut controls.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion post-onboarding regarding desktop controls (3 emails), and adding new finish steps has strong support in historical lessons.

new_companion_guide.headline: Desktop Companion Quick Controls
new_companion_guide.body: Double-click your pet to chat, drag to reposition, or right-click to send to system tray.

guard.reason: Adding a quick controls guide after home intro is permitted under rule 4 and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-onboarding confusion at finish step, but adding whole new flows carries mixed risk compared to standalone new screens.

candidates.title: Path Selection AI Pet Generation Hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on choose_path explaining the difference between pre-made pets and photo-based custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean 514s and 3 support emails reported issues with custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.

choose_path.hint: Pre-made pets load immediately, while custom pets use photo upload during adoption.

guard.reason: Adding informative hints to the choose path screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drops 23.8% of users, but prior test with hints on choose_path resulted in -1.2% conversion.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidance Wait Info
candidates.change: Provide photo quality guidelines and format hints directly on the upload_photos screen to prevent broken custom pet outputs.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and support received 3 tickets about custom pet generation failures.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Use a clear, well-lit photo facing forward for the best pet generation result.
upload_photos.hint: Supported formats: PNG, JPG. Ensure the pet subject is well-centered.

guard.reason: Adding quality guidance hints to the upload photos screen is valid.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the worst conversion (60.9%, losing 39.1%). Adding guidance via config is low cost with moderate potential.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Visibility Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Update home_intro text to clearly direct users where to locate their newly rendered pet on their screen or system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop upon setup, and finish screen copy adjustments can set clear user expectations.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Check your desktop corner or system tray icons to see your pet. Right-click anytime for options.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the home intro screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses reported desktop pet visibility issues, but previous finish copy test showed severe drop (-5.7%).

candidates.title: Path First Story Reorder Journey
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow so choose_path comes before story, letting users pick their intent immediately.
candidates.why: Step reordering proved significantly more effective than initial predictions in earlier tests (+6.6% actual vs +1.5% predicted for sign-in reorder).

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Sign In Profile Restore Reassurance Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores existing pets and guards against progress loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned lost/reset pets when signing back in. Clear sign-in copy directly addresses account loss anxiety.

sign_in.headline: Sync & Safeguard Your Pet Profile
sign_in.body: Sign in to save your adoption progress and restore any existing pets linked to your account.

guard.reason: Updating reassurance copy on the sign-in screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets top support concern (8 emails about account loss/resets). Sign-in optimizations have performed strongly.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Environment Progress Info
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and desktop ready notifications on the waiting screen while the desktop pet initializes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s; progress info and notification options reduce drop-off during long renders.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Desktop Pet Workspace
waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready to appear on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding time estimates and ready notifications to the waiting screen during real setup is allowed under rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Home step has a very long mean duration (2336s). Previous test for home wait_info yielded neutral results (0.0%).

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for most change types, with only sign-in hints, finish new screens, adoption redesigns, path choice hints, and home redesigns having at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints, finish new screens, and path choice hints were helpful as each kind included at least one winning test.
Adoption redesigns and home redesigns did not work, showing no clear effect or negative results across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Predictions were significantly too low for unexpected wins like path choice hints (-1.0% predicted vs +4.7% actual) and sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.7% actual).
